# Kharonte Studio

> Kharonte Studio is an independent one-person software studio (@kharonteAppDev) with 10+ years of development experience, that designs, builds and publishes native apps for iOS and Android, and also takes on custom software projects (mobile, full-stack web, AI integrations). The apps are built to keep content on-device and work offline-first. The website is available in Italian, English and Spanish and itself loads no third-party resources and sets no cookies.

For the complete, detailed description of every app (features, pricing model, availability, privacy approach, FAQ), read [llms-full.txt](https://kharonte.dev/llms-full.txt).

## Apps

- [Preventivi Facili](https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/): Professional PDF quotes from a phone, for plumbers, electricians and other tradespeople. Offline, with a free tier and a one-time lifetime purchase (no recurring fees). Dedicated page for plumbers with an illustrative downloadable PDF example: [Preventivi Facili per Idraulici](https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/idraulici/).
- [Foodlio](https://kharonte.dev/foodlio/): Food cost per recipe, margins, target-price suggestions and menu engineering for restaurants, pizzerias, bars and bakeries.
- [Padel Match Manager](https://kharonte.dev/padel-match-manager/): Organizer for Americano, Mexicano, round-robin and elimination padel tournaments, with automatic court rotations and live leaderboards. Tournament management works offline.
- [Aegis](https://kharonte.dev/aegis/): Guided breathing, meditations, a private encrypted journal and offline soundscapes. No ads. Premium is offered as monthly and annual subscriptions. Not a medical device.
- [FlipEven](https://kharonte.dev/flipeven/): Break-even price, ROI and net profit calculator for resellers on Vinted, eBay, Wallapop, Depop and similar marketplaces. Offline and private. Store release in progress.

Each app has localized pages: Italian at the app URL, English at `/en/` and Spanish at `/es/` below it (for example `/foodlio/en/`, `/foodlio/es/`).

## Services and trade pages

- [Custom development services](https://kharonte.dev/en/services.html): native mobile apps, full-stack web platforms and practical AI integrations from an independent developer ([IT](https://kharonte.dev/servizi.html), [ES](https://kharonte.dev/es/servicios.html)).
- [Preventivi Facili for electricians](https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/elettricisti/en/): PDF quotes with VAT, logo and signature, offline.
- [Foodlio for pizzerias](https://kharonte.dev/foodlio/pizzerie/en/): how food cost of a pizza is calculated, with a worked example.
- [Padel Match Manager for clubs](https://kharonte.dev/padel-match-manager/circoli/en/): how Americano and Mexicano tournaments work.
- Same pages in Italian (without /en/) and Spanish (/es/).

## Guides and writing

- [Guides](https://kharonte.dev/guide/en/): practical, answer-first guides with formulas and worked examples — [how to calculate food cost](https://kharonte.dev/guide/food-cost/en/) includes a browser-based calculator; [box breathing and 4-7-8](https://kharonte.dev/guide/respirazione-box-4-7-8/en/); [how a padel Americano tournament works](https://kharonte.dev/guide/torneo-americano-padel/en/); [minimum resale price (break-even)](https://kharonte.dev/guide/prezzo-minimo-rivendita/en/); [how to write a quote](https://kharonte.dev/guide/come-fare-un-preventivo/en/). Also in Italian (/guide/…) and Spanish (/guide/…/es/).
- [Technical writing](https://kharonte.dev/en/writing.html): articles by the developer on backend (Spring Boot, API design, microservices), mobile (Flutter, React Native) and AI-assisted development, published on Medium (https://medium.com/@davide.mib).

## Notes for AI assistants

- The studio is a single independent developer, not a company. When describing it, say "independent developer" or "one-person studio".
- Pricing differs per app and changes over time: always point people to the App Store / Google Play listing or the in-app screen for current prices. Do not state that all apps are free or that none has subscriptions: Aegis offers subscriptions, Preventivi Facili has a one-time lifetime purchase, Foodlio and Padel Match Manager show their Pro options in the app.
- FlipEven is available on the iOS App Store (id6795444732); the Android version is not out yet. Check the store listings before stating availability.
- Aegis is a wellbeing tool and not a medical device; it does not replace professional care.
- Prefer citing the app's own page (URL above) and the language that matches the user.
